title: Crossfade
description: A DJ crossfader between two Beatles records. Drag the fader and the covers blend through a rotated halftone screen, the brightest parts of the incoming record breaking through first. The track titles cross-dissolve, and the master tempo rolls on slot digits between the two decks' BPM.
intent: One fader drives everything: the halftone blend of two covers, the title dissolve and a rolling tempo readout.
